nom: Rael Miracle Patch Invisible Spot Cover

segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers report the microcrystals and adhesive can sting, tingle, or feel abrasive on removal, and one describes an allergic-looking red mark, though another with sensitive skin still saw a spot shrink without irritation.
segments.mature: A 58-year-old reviewer with normally good but newly breakout-prone skin reports calmer skin and no more large painful pimples after pairing the patches with Rael's cleanser and toner.

concerns.spots: Many reviewers describe stubborn whiteheads, cystic bumps, or under-the-skin pimples flattening or disappearing overnight; a minority (including cystic-acne cases) report no visible change after multiple applications.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers frequently report blemishes and surfaced pimples shrinking or clearing within hours to a couple of days, with some noting the patch pulls out pus or gunk; a few say the patches only cover the blemish without treating it.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers note reduced redness and inflammation within hours, and one reports a mosquito bite's redness disappearing overnight, though another reports the patch itself left a tender, burned-feeling red mark.

aspects.libelle: Large size and multiple sizes per sheet

extraits.texte: I have used a fairly large variety of spot patches and hydrocolloid based acne covers with mixed at best success. As with related products, I placed the Miracle Patches on problem areas after my p.m. skin care routine and left them on throughout the night. While I noticed a mild decrease in discoloration spots overall, the microcrystals were fairly uncomfortable during both application and removal. I imagine this is due to my sensitive skin's reaction to either the spiny texture of the microcrystals or the addition of succinic acid and tea tree oil on the patches. They may be fine for folks with more hearty skin than myself, but I have no interest irritating my skin with these further.

This package cam just in time. I had a HUGE pimple pop up out of nowhere. I used this patch immediately over night. When I woke to a decrease in its size. It was very comfortable and didn't seem to dry the area out too much. the spot was free from irritation as I can have sensitive skin.

extraits.titre: Works very well, tough on sensitive skin
extraits.texte: These spot patches work wonders but are tough on sensitive skin. The adhesive was a bit abrasive and uncomfortable when removing, but also worked wonders at reducing/removing blemishes as well. Would definitely recommend this product!

I'm 58 years old and normally have good skin. But recently, I've started breaking out with large, painful pimples that took weeks to go away. Some of them were so big... I couldn't even cover them with make-up. I began using these patches - along with Rael's cleanser and toner for acne-prone skin - and the difference has been night and day. My skin has calmed down. I've had no breakouts of those monster pimples. And any pimples I've had, I apply the overnight patch right away. Within a couple of days, they're completely gone. This product - along with the cleanser and toner - has saved my skin.

extraits.titre: Left horrible mark on my face!
extraits.texte: I have pimple patches from another brand and had no issues with them. Wanted to use a cleaner brand so I tried these. It left a horrible mark on my face exactly the size of the patch. It was also tender to touch and felt burned the day after I removed the patch. The point of this patch is to not pick at pimple and prevent scaring. This left a far worse scar then had I popped the pimple. Would never use these again!
Got it cos of the rave about it and wasn't disappointed Cleared my cystic acne in 2 days. Love that it actually stays and doesn't slide. Bit pricy but love it

extraits.titre: Honestly my top fav of this year
extraits.texte: As someone who frequents with K and J beauty, I was shocked that a western brand was so effective. The tea tree (though maybe too sensitive for some, please patch test before using) has such a wonderful tingling feeling similar to Burt's Bees Lip Balm. 24 hours later I could most certainly feel a complete 180° when washing my face like my hands almost flew off it was so smooth. I can't get enough!
